title: Why Jesus?
message: Before anything existed, Jesus did. John doesn't open with a manger — he opens with eternity: "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God." That Word became flesh and moved into our neighborhood. So Jesus isn't a good teacher who showed up in history — He's the eternal God who stepped into it. Whatever you've believed about Him before today, start here: He is Lord over all things, and He came near on purpose.
explore: Jesus as Lord, Son, Savior and the One through whom all things were made.
reflect: What have you previously believed about Jesus? Who is Jesus to you today?
pray: Jesus, help me to see You more clearly. Give me an open heart as I discover who You are.
